set.crosshair.shape.help: A mark in the centre of the view for lining up a gap. Off by default, like a real FPV feed. Never drawn into your videos, hidden in cinema mode.
set.crosshair.size.help: As a share of the screen's shorter side, so it looks the same on a phone and on a big monitor.
set.crosshair.color.help: Pick one that stands out on the scan you fly.
set.crosshair.opacity.help: 1 is solid; lower lets the scan show through.
